title: Other agents' sessions: every Claude Code session on this repository kept, credentials removed, a tester's machine reading none of its own
request: Keep every other agent's actions, decisions and tasks: the development sessions (Claude Code, worktrees included), testers' sessions with their yes, and MCP clients' calls as their own source.
plan: Read Claude Code's folders of this repository: the main checkout, each worktree, each subfolder session.
Keep transcripts by their new lines, credentials removed line by line.
Keep each MCP call whole, whether it worked or not.
Keep testers' sessions only through their share.

decisions.decision: Credentials are removed at capture, not later.
decisions.why: The store is pushed to a repository; a key a person pasted must never reach it.

decisions.decision: A tester's machine reads none of its own Claude Code sessions unless named explicitly.
decisions.why: A tester's sessions are theirs; only their share, with their yes, brings them.
No redaction can read text in a picture of a desktop.

change: dclab_rnd.store.keepers.agents (folders, SECRET, redact, projects_folder, counted images), the classes mcp/ and claude_code/, mcp_server._keep_call, DCLAB_STORE_CLAUDE_PROJECTS.

findings.scenario: A fine-grained GitHub token, a Google or Slack key, a private key, a password in a connection string, a JWT, a Kaggle key.
findings.cause: The pattern knew a few key prefixes.
findings.fix: One pattern for every common shape, and for a key or a secret named in an assignment.

findings.defect: A tester's own sessions would be kept without their yes.
findings.scenario: A tester runs the studio from a checkout of this repository: every session of theirs kept as the owner's.
findings.cause: The default folder was read on every machine.
findings.fix: On a tester's machine none is read unless named explicitly.

findings.defect: No MCP call was kept on PostgreSQL, nor a call that failed.
findings.scenario: PostgreSQL's stores have no home; a raising tool skipped the log.
findings.cause: The log used the file store's home and ran after success only.
findings.fix: The stores' files home, and the call kept in a finally with its error.

findings.defect: Desktop screenshots would be pushed whole.
findings.scenario: About 200 tool-result images in the transcripts' folders.

findings.defect: Direct test runs read the owner's real transcripts.
findings.scenario: A unittest run outside the parallel runner copied 1.1 GB.
findings.cause: The keeper read the default folder when the test gave none.
findings.fix: The tests name an empty folder; the runner turns the reading off.

outcome: Every Claude Code session on this repository is kept, its credentials removed, and nothing of a tester's machine is read without their yes.
lessons: Remove secrets where data is captured; every later layer can be skipped.
A test that reads a default folder reads the developer's machine.
risks: A credential shape no pattern knows still reaches raw; the pattern is the only guard.
